author: Cosplayin
body:
Name: Cosplayin

Reason: Ban Evading

Why I should be unbanned:  Well, to be completely honest I have not played on avicus or on any other server much over the last 2-3 years and everything is pretty fuzzy to me. I came onto avicus to reconnect with some old pals and hopefully meet some new people. I didn't mean to ban evade it has just been to long and I didn't even know what the term meant until I was explained by MidnightStorm on the teamspeak server. I would really love to unbanned and talk to old friends who probably wouldn't remember me. I'd enjoy to become part of the community once again and help out with whatever be needed. I would literally do anything to get unbanned.. well, almost everything but i really am sincere. The reason I got banned in the first place was for racism which I did not intend to do. I was just excited to see an old person in-game and decided to say something that came across very inappropriate. I really do hope to be unbanned and rekindle old friendships. Thank you for taking your time to read this appeal from many other and I bid you farewell. Also, have a nice day! c:

title: Cosplayin - Appeal

replies.author: Eteh
replies.body:
Hey Cosplayin,

You were caught ban evading and we do not make any exceptions to any players when it comes to appealing it. However, you can appeal your ban again in 6-8 months. This appeal has been denied.

Regards,
Eteh

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
As stated above, you were caught using the account https://avicus.net/MedicalResponder on your recent IP. If you can explain why this account is not related to you, you will be appealed. If not, you will be punished for another 6-8 months. I will keep this open for 24 hours until you respond.

Regards,
Edans

replies.author: Cosplayin
replies.body: I'm not going to deny it. I was using medicalresponder as an alt account and I'm not going to make up excuses about how it was my brother because I don't have a brother nor would it help me out in the entire conflict. It took me two years to come back to avicus and I'm not sure if I'll even come back in six months. I know that you guys don't care much but that's alright. Anyways, it's cool that you guys responded quickly and for that i thank you.

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

First of all, I'd like to thank you for your honestly. Seriously! You're probably the first person I've seen with a proper explanation, and I'd like to thank you for that. Regardless, I'm sorry but your punishment really can't get appealed, you've gained so many infractions and we can't let people with that many simply get away with it. I'm sorry, but your appeal has been denied.

Thanks!
